The '''1988–89 Football League Cup''' (known as the [[Littlewoods]] Challenge Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the 29th season of the [[EFL Cup|Football League Cup]], a knockout competition for England's top 92 football clubs. The competition started on 29 August 1988 and ended with the [[1989 Football League Cup final|final]] on 9 April 1989.

The [[1989 Football League Cup final|final]] was contested by [[1988–89 Football League#First Division|First Division]] teams [[Nottingham Forest F.C.|Nottingham Forest]] and holders [[Luton Town F.C.|Luton Town]] at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]] in [[London]].

==Semi-finals==
Nottingham Forest, flying high in the First Division, had a narrow victory over Third Division underdogs Bristol City in the semi-finals, while holders Luton Town enjoyed a comfortable triumph over West Ham United in both legs.
